title: LGPD: legal bases, data subject rights and impact assessments

videos.script: Customer 3 writes to Ipê on a Saturday. Delete my data. {{request}} It sounds like one statement. In the database it is six orders, four prescriptions, two support tickets and a consent to marketing, and the law says something different about each. {{rows}} The tickets can go. The orders and the prescriptions stay, because tax law and the health authority require them, and from that day they serve that obligation and nothing else. {{decide}} This lesson reads the LGPD as somebody who runs the data. Which legal basis covers each purpose. Consent recorded as events, so it can be proven and withdrawn. An export that finds everything about one person, because the classification of lesson 6 says where to look. {{export}} A table that knows when every answer is due, and a query that finds the one that is six days late. {{late}} And the facts of an impact assessment, computed rather than remembered. {{facts}} The law asks what you hold, about whom, for what, and for how long. By the end of this lesson, each of those is a query. {{end}}
